text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Ensuite, elle fait la synthèse des co-rapports et avis reçus et les inscrit sur la liste des divergences.", "gist": "The office synthesizes co-reports and opinions received and records them on a list of divergences."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Le jour de sa séance, le Conseil fédéral se référera à cette liste pour discuter des dossiers et prendre des décisions.", "gist": "On the day of its session, the Federal Council will refer to this list to discuss cases and make decisions."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "A l’issue de la réunion, la Section établit les décisions du Conseil fédéral et en informe les départements.", "gist": "At the end of the meeting, the Section establishes the Federal Council's decisions and informs the departments."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "art. 15, al. 2, LOGA", "gist": "Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Federal Act on the Organisation of the Government and Administration"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Chancellerie fédérale", "gist": "Federal Chancellery"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Directives sur les affaires du Conseil fédéral", "gist": "Directives on Federal Council Affairs"}]}
